name: io.github.casahome2000/graphmyanything-mcp
title: GraphMyAnything
description: Metric memory for agents: track, query, insight, chart. Local SQLite with optional hosted sync and shareable chart links at graphmyanything.com/c/<id>.

environmentVariables.name: GRAPHMYANYTHING_CHARTS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional chart SVG output directory (default: charts/ beside DB, or ~/.graphmyanything/charts/)

environmentVariables.name: GRAPHMYANYTHING_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional hosted API key (Bearer). Use after sync or from your account.
